title: Reconcile foreman-agent-state-campaign skill with the hook-driven agent-state plan
body:
The skill (.claude/skills/foreman-agent-state-campaign/SKILL.md) contradicts the merged agent-state spec and plan, and CLAUDE.md routes per-Session agent-state work to it, so workers on cards tvmsrv (build the plan) and gmm453 (idle-aware chat delivery) will read it first.

Contradictions:
1. Route. The skill recommends output-based detection: option (a), a composite state machine over output quiescence x cursor-rest x recent-injection. It ranks explicit agent cooperation (hooks) last, as option (d), 'phase-3 candidate, NOT phase 2'. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-25-agent-state-design.md and plans/2026-09-25-agent-state.md choose hooks outright (foreman title-event over the existing title pipe, same shape as Warp's claude-code-warp plugin).
2. Next step. The skill says Phase 0 (READY_GRACE) comes before any detector or badge. The plan starts at the pure state slot and never mentions READY_GRACE. READY_GRACE is still unbuilt (only a comment in src/ready.rs); decide whether it stays as a separate hardening item, not a gate on this work.
3. Status. The skill says DESIGN-STAGE, nothing built, confirm with rg READY_GRACE|agentstate. The spec and plan are merged. Update the status line to match reality, and again when tvmsrv lands.
4. Fenced wrong paths (section 8) and the promotion path (section 10) were written for the output-based route; check each against the hook decision and drop or reword what no longer holds.

Do: rewrite the skill so it points at the spec and plan as the current route, keeps what is still true (why PTY bytes cannot show turn state, the validation protocol, the gotchas about injecting at the wrong moment), and demotes the output-based detector to a fallback for agents with no hooks. Check whether a .codex/skills twin exists and keep it in sync. Also re-check the cross-links in docs/warp-feature-candidates.md and the CLAUDE.md routing row. Docs only, no code. Follow foreman-docs-and-writing (no line numbers, no counts).
